evidence: Plin. Ep. 6.16.4: nūbem inūsitātā et magnitūdine et speciē
terms.comment: Size of any kind, large or small: minōrēs sunt magnitūdine, they are smaller in size (Varro, Lewis & Short); ad fabae magnitūdinem, the size of a bean (Celsus, Lewis & Short). How big? Quantus? — Tantus! (see so big!).

evidence: Cic. Verr. 2.4.49: simulācrum modicā amplitūdine (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Size as extent and bulk; only in prose (Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: hōrā ferē septimā māter mea indicat eī appārēre nūbem inūsitātā et magnitūdine et speciē.
phrases.english: at about the seventh hour my mother points out to him a cloud of unusual size and appearance.

sources: Lewis & Short: magnitudo · Lewis & Short: amplitudo · Lewis & Short: statura
